_comment: Glass opacity presets (item_139): the ONE table for surface alpha. Read by Commons/Appearance.qml (panel/card fills), scripts/theme-switch.py (kitty background_opacity) and scripts/contrast-check.py --glass (text contrast over a mid-grey wallpaper at each preset). panel = frame/panel glass, panelAlt = its lighter twin + sheen stops, card = dashboard/settings cards. soft is the pre-item_139 look (light panels raised 0.92/0.90 -> 0.96/0.95 so text stays AA over a mid-grey wallpaper) and the default. Light panels cannot go below ~0.94 without dropping gruvbox-light text under AA over mid-grey; dark stops at ~0.82 (monochrome). A pack material flat/matte stays opaque whatever the preset.
